title: Transcript: Archbishop Timothy Broglio on "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan," April 5, 2026
summary: The following is the full transcript of the interview with Archbishop Timothy Broglio of the Archdiocese for the Military Services U.S.A. a portion of which will air on "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" on April 5, 2026. The interview was taped on April 2, 2026.
